officialInventory.summary: No public protected-area register from the Department of Wildlife and National Parks (DWNP) was found online (DWNP has no standalone website; the Botswana Tourism site returned errors). The authoritative list is statutory: the Wildlife Conservation and National Parks Act (Cap. 38:01) declares national parks (First Schedule), game reserves and sanctuaries (Second Schedule), wildlife management areas (Third Schedule) and controlled hunting areas (Fourth Schedule). The freely available consolidated text (FAOLEX) runs to 2007; the Sua Pan Flamingo Sanctuary (S.I. 38 of 2010) was added from its own order. Forest reserves come from the Forest (Declaration of Forest Reserves) Order. The current (2023-2024 amended) consolidated Act is behind a paywall, so later changes may be missing. Category totals from the 5th CBD report (2015, Table 5): national parks 44,390 km2 (7%); game reserves 59,590 + 408 km2 (10%); legislated WMAs 72,090 km2 (23%) plus 65,780 km2 not legislated; forest reserves 4,095.4 km2 (1%). DWNP's PoWPA submission: 'About 40% of the Botswana’s land area has been devoted to protected areas, with 17% being national parks and game reserves'.

sources.note: Act 28 of 1992, commenced 11 December 1992. First Schedule = National Parks (s.5); Second Schedule = Game Reserves and Sanctuaries (s.12); Third Schedule = Wildlife Management Areas (s.15); Fourth Schedule = Controlled Hunting Areas (s.16). Later amendments (Act 15 of 2023; S.I. 122 of 2023; S.I. 16 and 74 of 2024) are listed on botswanalaws.com but the current schedules there are paywalled.

notEnumerated.category: private game reserves (Declaration of Private Game Reserve(s) Orders)
notEnumerated.reason: Declared farm by farm under orders amended many times (1968-2008); full current list not freely available.
5th CBD report: Kgalagadi District WMAs have land board approval but were not gazetted (65,780 km2 'not legislated').

gaps: The freely available consolidated Wildlife Conservation and National Parks Act (FAOLEX) is current only to S.I. 80 of 2007; amendments by Act 15 of 2023 and S.I.s of 2023-2024 could not be read (paywalled), so any newer parks, reserves or WMAs are missing.
Establishment years for national parks and game reserves (pre-1992 declarations under the National Parks Act and Fauna Conservation Act) were not found in an official source and are left null.
Per-area sizes are not given in the Act or the 5th CBD report (which only gives category totals), so areaKm2 is null except where stated.

Areas often described as protected (Khama Rhino Sanctuary, Mokolodi Nature Reserve, Nata Bird Sanctuary, Mashatu, Okavango Delta as a whole) do not appear in the Act's schedules; they are community, private or international designations and were not added.
Current status of the forest reserves after the partial degazetting noted in the 5th CBD report (2015) was not verified.

No official coordinates were used; points depend on Wikidata matches. Gemsbok National Park has no QID because Wikidata only has the binational Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park (Q859385); sanctuaries, WMAs and most forest reserves had no matching item (Wikidata was rate-limited, so only a keyword search was run).
